dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight, word around town is that the charity sale was a runaway success, all thanks to you, Paimon, Bernhard, and Mats!

dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: Even I got a taste of the limelight, getting a few "thank you" notes of my own...

choices.text: This is the result of our collaborative efforts.

response.speaker: Pauline
response.text: I haven't done enough, not as much as you guys.

response.speaker: Pauline
response.text: However, after listening to your business strategy, I felt I have learned a lot and have become a more skilled businesswoman!

response.speaker: Pauline
response.text: Please make sure to look for me when you get the chance.
